lines: > There's something I need to ask you... in person. Come see me on a Relay and we'll talk.
- Darvo: "Ah, Tenno, you got my message?"
- Darvo: "Listen, I have a little job for you, interested?"
- Darvo: "So, Tenno, you up for a little job on the side?"
- Darvo: "The Grineer have gone too far. They're about to execute one of my most trusted contractors."
- Darvo: "They say he's a "traitor" and that he was trying to "steal" a priceless artifact. Baseless acquisations. That's not the kind of business I engage in."
- Darvo: "So, what do you say? Will you help him out? And don't worry, you will get paid too."
- Darvo: "These clods are holding my contractor somewhere in this complex. Please find him."
- Darvo: "Every so often they mess up and make a Grineer who doesn't bow down to the Queens. My contractor is such a Grineer..."
- Darvo: "So be careful not to shoot him in the face when you see him. Okay?"
- Darvo: "The Grineer, they are waiting for you. Expect some big time resistance."
- Darvo: "Get to him quick, before they do their worst."
- Darvo: "Follow the Tenno, Clem. They're friends."
- Darvo: "No... no, Clem... no, they don't have your Grakatas. Just... just follow the Tenno. Okay?"
- Darvo: "No... Clem. How could you let this happen?"
- Darvo: "Clem says thank you for busting him out. Good work."
- Darvo: "You did it. You got Clem. He's a special guy, you know. Little weird, but a hell of a fighter. And that's the thing – he still needs your help to retrieve his custom weapons."
- Darvo: "Clem needs to get back into fighting shape. Find his missing weapons."
- Darvo: "Poor Clem. He's utterly useless without his custom Grakatas... but with them? Well, you'll see."
- Darvo: "Tenno, Clem wants you guys to go after the Grineer that stole his Grakatas."
- Darvo: "I'm just going to assume you're up for that. Check your map."
- Darvo: "Don't think he'll be messing with you again. Come on home."
- Darvo: "Clem has his Grakatas; now it's time to get down to business and liberate that artifact. If you help Clem, we can all share in the spoils."

path: Help Darvo get the relic: Puck, Uranus
lines: - Darvo: "This is it, the merchandise acquisition mission. You and Clem cause a ruckus while my other operative steals the artifact. Let 'em know you're here."
- Darvo: "They cut off life support. You gonna let them intimidate you like that?"
- Darvo: "Hey, look, these guys are dropping life support modules all over the place! That's convenient."
- Darvo: "Deal time! You interested in some half-price life support?? Hehe, just kidding. Here comes another."
- Darvo: "Hey, don't forget about this capsule."
- Darvo: "You should think about finding a capsule."
- Darvo: "It's getting stuffy down there, Tenno. Turn on some life support."
- Darvo: "We got the artifact! The Potent Orokin Technical Augmentation and Tactical Offensive device. Haha! It's super hard to say. POTATO."
- Darvo: "We got what we need, so let's head home."
**Running out of life support after 10 minutes**
- Darvo: "You should extract, now. No, really, go. If you don't you will die! Seriously go!"
- Darvo: "You did it. I knew you could handle this."
- Darvo: "Clem is very glad you saved him from certain death."
- Darvo: "Oh, oh yeah, and that you got his Grakatas back, too."
- Darvo: "And I'm happy to have this fancy Orokin relic. Here's a little something as a symbol of our appreciation."
- Darvo: "Thanks again, Tenno. Don't be a stranger."
